notes.title: 1.1 Update Note
notes.content:
Update details

Stage 1 (Internal Building)

I've noticed that it's hard to find a key.
- Added room number for all rooms.
- Now all Items are shiny.
- Hint Document added.

Stage 2 (City)
-Remove stack space

Behavioral 
- If the "E" is pressed, only the items will be taken without delay.
- If the "l-shift" key is pressed, the running status is maintained.
- Added jump animation without weapons.


Inventory
-You can zoom in on items now.
-A cancellation function has been added when using the item.
-The Item Usage UI has been changed.
- If you throw away your weapon, you've modified the bug that the ammo disappears.

Localization
-Some words have been modified.


If there is a misinterpretation, please submit it to the community bulletin. 
Please raise it and I'll correct it right away.
(Sorry, there may also be incorrect words in update notes.)
